extracted.intended_audience: Researchers and research organisations interested in applying for STFC / UKRI funding (particularly UK particle physics and invited metascience applicants)
extracted.subtask_description: Extracts the eligibility, scope, administrative and funding requirements for two STFC/UKRI funding opportunities (Particle Physics Experiment Consolidated Grants 2026 and the invite-only UKRI metascience scientometrics call). Useful for prospective applicants preparing submissions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Applicant location and institutional eligibility (Particle Physics Experiment Consolidated Grants 2026)
rubrics_metrics.description: You must be based at a UK research organisation eligible for Science and Technology Facilities Council (STFC) funding and a member of the UK particle physics community.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is an explicit eligibility requirement for applicants to the Particle Physics Experiment Consolidated Grants 2026 round; only applicants meeting both institutional (eligible UK research organisation) and community membership (UK particle physics community) tests should apply.

rubrics_metrics.name: Scope of research (Particle Physics Experiment Consolidated Grants 2026)
rubrics_metrics.description: This grant round will consider grant requests to support particle physics experiment research.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applications should propose work that falls within particle physics experiment research; proposals outside this scope are unlikely to be considered.

rubrics_metrics.name: Application window and deadlines (Particle Physics Experiment Consolidated Grants 2026)
rubrics_metrics.description: Opening date: 11 May 2026 9:00am UK time. Closing date: 9 July 2026 4:00pm UK time.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applications must be submitted within the published opening and closing times; opportunity status is listed as 'Upcoming' (published 1 May 2026). Ensure submission systems and institutional approvals are arranged to meet the deadline.

rubrics_metrics.name: Invitation requirement (UKRI metascience scientometrics for research assessment)
rubrics_metrics.description: You must be invited to apply for this funding opportunity.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This call is strictly invite-only; unsolicited applications from uninvited applicants will not be accepted. Confirm invitation status before preparing a full application.

rubrics_metrics.name: Scope and aims (UKRI metascience scientometrics for research assessment)
rubrics_metrics.description: Apply for funding to develop, validate, and critique novel scientometric indicators for use in research assessment and in metascience research.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Proposals should address development, validation, or critical appraisal of new scientometric indicators with clear relevance to research assessment and metascience. Align proposals to the stated aims to be competitive.

rubrics_metrics.name: Funding amount and cost coverage (UKRI metascience scientometrics for research assessment)
rubrics_metrics.description: We expect to fund up to � million at 80% full economic cost (FEC). Total fund: �,000,000.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Budget proposals should be prepared on the FEC basis with only 80% of FEC requested from funders. Plan co-funding or institutional contributions accordingly and ensure budgets match the stated maximum award level.

rubrics_metrics.name: Funders and co-funders (UKRI metascience scientometrics for research assessment)
rubrics_metrics.description: Funders: UK Research and Innovation, ESRC, NERC, BBSRC, AHRC, STFC, EPSRC, MRC. Co-funders: Department for Science, Innovation and Technology (DSIT).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Be aware of the multi-council nature of the funding and the involvement of DSIT as a co-funder; this may affect eligibility, priorities, assessment criteria and reporting expectations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Administrative metadata to note (both opportunities)
rubrics_metrics.description: Each opportunity lists publication date, opening/closing dates, opportunity status, funders, funding type and total fund where applicable.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants should record and follow the administrative details shown (publication date, opening/closing, status, funder list, funding type) as they determine application timing, funder expectations and whether the call is appropriate for the proposed work.
